# Higher Heights Films

> UK video production company. Corporate video, brand films, product, events
> and aerial - directed, shot and edited by one person. Based in London,
> filming worldwide.

Higher Heights Films is the trading name of Higher Heights (London) Limited,
registered in England & Wales, company number 17461146.

## What we make

- Corporate video: recruitment and culture films, company and brand stories,
  product and service explainers, case studies, conference coverage
- Event videography: conferences, launches, awards, sport, brand activations
- Aerial and drone filming: property, landscape, automotive, marine, events
- Product film and stills
- Social cutdowns from the same shoot

- [Aerial and drone filming](https://higherheights.uk/aerial-drone-filming)

## How it works

One director who shoots and edits, rather than a crew with handovers. Most
jobs are one or two shoot days and deliver a main film plus social cutdowns
from the same shoot.
